63123-the-eyes-of-thar.title: The Eyes Of Thar
63123-the-eyes-of-thar.creator: Unknown
63123-the-eyes-of-thar.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The girl--he had not thought of her for years; he did not want to remember. He had been young when it happened. Of Earth stock, he had during a great Martian drought become godson to an old shaman of Klanvahr, one of the priests who still hoarded scraps of the forgotten knowledge of the past, glorious days of Martian destiny, when bright towers had fingered up triumphantly toward the Eyes of Thar.

arxiv-1809-05098.title: Colloquium: Ionic phenomena in nanoscale pores through 2D materials
arxiv-1809-05098.creator: Subin Sahu, Michael Zwolak
arxiv-1809-05098.description: Abstract Ion transport through nanopores permeates through many areas of science and technology, from cell behavior to sensing and separation to catalysis and batteries. Two-dimensional materials, such as graphene, molybdenum disulfide (MoS 2 ), and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), are recent additions to these fields.

arxiv-1911-05001.title: Control of Graphene Layer Thickness Grown on Plasma Enhanced Atomic Layer Deposition of Molybdenum Carbide
arxiv-1911-05001.creator: Eldad Grady, W.M.M. Kessels, Ageeth A. Bol
arxiv-1911-05001.description: Abstract We show the merits of plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) of catalytic substrate for chemical vapour deposition (CVD) graphene growth. The high quality multilayer graphene (MLG) on molybdenum carbide ( M ​ o ​ C x MoC_{x} ) thin film exhibits excellent uniformity and layer homogeneity over a large area.

arxiv-2103-10168.title: Conformal correlators in the critical O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) vector model
arxiv-2103-10168.creator: Noam Chai, Mikhail Goykhman, and Ritam Sinha
arxiv-2103-10168.description: Abstract We calculate a set of conformal correlators in the critical O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) vector model in 2 < d < 6 2<d<6 dimensions. We focus on the correlators involving the Hubbard-Stratonovich field s s , and its composite form s 2 s^{2} .

arxiv-2104-01778.title: AST: Audio Spectrogram Transformer
arxiv-2104-01778.creator: Yuan Gong, Yu-An Chung, James Glass
arxiv-2104-01778.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yuan Gong, Yu-An Chung, James Glass. In the past decade, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been widely adopted as the main building block for end-to-end audio classification models, which aim to learn a direct mapping from audio spectrograms to corresponding labels. To better capture long-range global context, a recent trend is to add a self-attention mechanism on top of the CNN, forming a CNN-attention hybrid model.

arxiv-2105-05018.title: Optimizing the Phase Estimation Algorithm Applied to the Quantum Simulation of Heisenberg-Type Hamiltonians
arxiv-2105-05018.creator: Scott Johnstun, Jean-François Van Huele
arxiv-2105-05018.description: Abstract The phase estimation algorithm is a powerful quantum algorithm with applications in cryptography, number theory, and simulation of quantum systems. We use this algorithm to simulate the time evolution of a system of two spin-1/2 particles under a Heisenberg Hamiltonian. The evolution is performed through both classical simulations of quantum computers and real quantum computers via IBM’s Qiskit platform.

arxiv-2204-04639.title: Lipschitz stability of γ \gamma -FOCS and RC canonical Jordan bases of real H H -selfadjoint matrices under small perturbations Journal: TBD
arxiv-2204-04639.creator: S. Dogruer Akgul, A. Minenkova, V. Olshevsky
arxiv-2204-04639.description: Abstract In 2008 Bella, Olshevsky and Prasad proved that the flipped orthogonal (FO) Jordan bases of H H -selfadjoint matrices are Lipschitz stable under small perturbations. In 2022, Dogruer, Minenkova and Olshevsky considered the real case, and proved that for real H H -selfadjoint matrices there exist a more refined bases called FOCS bases.

arxiv-2204-13727.title: The impact of ultraviolet heating and cooling on the dynamics and observability of lava planet atmospheres 2021 The impact of ultraviolet heating and cooling on the dynamics and observability of lava planet atmospheres – A
arxiv-2204-13727.creator: T. Giang Nguyen, Nicolas B. Cowan, Raymond T. Pierrehumbert, Roxana E. Lupu, John E. Moores
arxiv-2204-13727.description: Abstract Lava planets have non-global, condensible atmospheres similar to icy bodies within the solar system. Because they depend on interior dynamics, studying the atmospheres of lava planets can lead to understanding unique geological processes driven by their extreme environment. Models of lava planet atmospheres have thus far focused on either radiative transfer or hydrodynamics.

arxiv-2302-01385.title: Hyper-parameter Tuning for Fair Classification without Sensitive Attribute Access
arxiv-2302-01385.creator: Akshaj Kumar Veldanda akv275@nyu.edu, Ivan Brugere ivan.brugere@jpmchase.com, Sanghamitra Dutta sanghamd@umd.edu, Alan Mishler alan.mishler@jpmchase.com, Siddharth Garg sg175@nyu.edu
arxiv-2302-01385.description: Abstract Fair machine learning methods seek to train models that balance model performance across demographic subgroups defined over sensitive attributes like race and gender. Although sensitive attributes are typically assumed to be known during training, they may not be available in practice due to privacy and other logistical concerns.

arxiv-2503-05243.title: Nonstabilizerness of a Boundary Time Crystal
arxiv-2503-05243.creator: Gianluca Passarelli, Angelo Russomanno, Procolo Lucignano
arxiv-2503-05243.description: Abstract Boundary time crystals exhibit measurement-induced phase transitions in their steady-state entanglement, with critical behavior that depends on the particular unraveling of the Lindblad dynamics. In this work, we investigate another key measure of quantum complexity—nonstabilizerness (or “magic”)—and show that it follows a markedly different pattern.

arxiv-2509-19437.title: Quantum Dynamics of Electron Scattering from Skyrmions
arxiv-2509-19437.creator: Hareram Swain, Arijit Mandal, S. Satpathy, B. R. K. Nanda
arxiv-2509-19437.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hareram Swain, Arijit Mandal, S. Satpathy, B. R. K. Nanda. Scattering of electrons from chiral spin textures such as the skyrmions is an emerging research area due to its richness in topological quantum transport, which is significant for spintronic devices. We study the dynamical process of scattering of the spin- 1 2 \frac{1}{2} particles in the form of Gaussian wavepackets from skyrmions with the aid of the non-relativistic time-dependent Schrödinger equation.

arxiv-2510-14032.title: Vgent: Graph-based Retrieval-Reasoning-Augmented Generation For Long Video Understanding
arxiv-2510-14032.creator: Xiaoqian Shen, Wenxuan Zhang, Jun Chen, Mohamed Elhoseiny
arxiv-2510-14032.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiaoqian Shen, Wenxuan Zhang, Jun Chen, Mohamed Elhoseiny. Understanding and reasoning over long videos pose significant challenges for large video language models (LVLMs) due to the difficulty in processing intensive video tokens beyond context window and retaining long-term sequential information. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has demonstrated effectiveness in processing long context for Large Language Models (LLMs); however, applying RAG to long video faces challenges such as disrupted temporal dependencies and inclusion of irrelevant information that can hinder accurate reasoning.

arxiv-2512-20042.title: Beyond Vision: Contextually Enriched Image Captioning with Multi-Modal Retrieval DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: 2025 ACM Multimedia Conference; October 27–31, 2025; Dublin, Ireland ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Computing methodologies
arxiv-2512-20042.creator: Nguyen Lam Phu Quy, Pham Phu Hoa, Tran Chi Nguyen, Dao Sy Duy Minh, Nguyen Hoang Minh Ngoc, Huynh Trung Kiet
arxiv-2512-20042.description: Abstract . Real-world image captions often lack contextual depth, omitting crucial details such as event background, temporal cues, outcomes, and named entities that are not visually discernible. This gap limits the effectiveness of image understanding in domains like journalism, education, and digital archives, where richer, more informative descriptions are essential.

arxiv-2602-03841.title: Cosmological Correlator Discontinuities from Scattering Amplitudes
arxiv-2602-03841.creator: Chandramouli Chowdhury a, Sadra Jazayeri b, Arthur Lipstein c, Joe Marshall c, Jiajie Mei d, Ivo Sachs e
arxiv-2602-03841.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Chandramouli Chowdhury a, Sadra Jazayeri b, Arthur Lipstein c, Joe Marshall c, Jiajie Mei d, Ivo Sachs e. Recent theoretical work has revealed that basic observables of quantum field theory in de Sitter space, known as in-in or cosmological correlators, exhibit surprisingly simple mathematical structure reminiscent of scattering amplitudes in flat space.

pmc-10710299.description: The distribution of antibiotic-resistance genes (ARGs) in environmental soil is greatly affected by livestock and poultry manure fertilization, the application of manure will lead to antibiotic residues and ARGs pollution, and increase the risk of environmental pollution and human health. Cinnamomum camphora is an economically significant tree species in Fujian Province, China.

pmc-11359239.title: RobotSDF: Implicit Morphology Modeling for the Robotic Arm
pmc-11359239.creator: Yusheng Yang, Jiajia Liu, Hongpeng Zhou, Afimbo Reuben Kwabena, Yuqiao Zhong, Yangmin Xie
pmc-11359239.description: The expression of robot arm morphology is a critical foundation for achieving effective motion planning and collision avoidance in robotic systems. Traditional geometry-based approaches usually suffer from the contradiction between the high demand for computing resources for fine expression and the insufficient detail expression caused by the pursuit of efficiency.

pmc-11534993.title: Digital health intervention for children with ADHD to improve mental health intervention, patient experiences, and outcomes: a study protocol
pmc-11534993.creator: Nancy Herrera, Franceli L Cibrian, Lucas M Silva, Jesus Armando Beltran, Sabrina E B Schuck, Gillian R Hayes, Kimberley D Lakes
pmc-11534993.description: BackgroundAttention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is the most prevalent childhood psychiatric condition with profound public health, personal, and family consequences. ADHD requires comprehensive treatment; however, lack of communication and integration across multiple points of care is a substantial barrier to progress. Given the chronic and pervasive challenges associated with ADHD, innovative approaches are crucial.

pmc-11621051.title: Association between cardiovascular health and human papillomavirus infection: analysis from NHANES 2005–2016
pmc-11621051.creator: Meng Li, Meiying Song
pmc-11621051.description: BackgroundGiven the strong association between cardiovascular disease and human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, this study aimed to assess the correlation between HPV infection and cardiovascular health (CVH) as represented by the Life’s Essential 8 (LE8) score.MethodsThis study employed analysis of data obtained from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey covering the period from 2005 to 2016.

pmc-12587040.title: Revitalizing cephalosporins: The promise of β-lactamase inhibitor combinations
pmc-12587040.creator: Kazi-Chishti Marzooka, Shaikh Sajed, Mohamed Hassan Dehghan, Kazi Bilal, Rumani Imaan
pmc-12587040.description: This review explore the rise of multidrug-resistant (MDR) Gram-negative bacteria, highlighting β-lactamase inhibitor combinations as crucial therapeutic options. It examines β-lactam resistance mechanisms, established combinations (e.g., ticarcillin/clavulanic acid, piperacillin/tazobactam), and the clinical efficacy of newer therapies like ceftazidime/avibactam (CAZ-AVI) for carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CRKP) and ceftolozane/tazobactam (TOL-TAZ) for MDR Pseudomonas aeruginosa. pmc-12607078.title: Perioperative cognitive behavioural therapy compared with pain education and mindfulness for chronic postsurgical pain in breast cancer patients with high pain catastrophising characteristics: a randomised, controlled, parallel group clinical trial☆
pmc-12607078.creator: Aneurin Moorthy, Damien Lowry, Carla Edgely, Margarita Blajeva, Máire-Bríd Casey, Donal J. Buggy
pmc-12607078.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe incidence of chronic postsurgical pain (CPSP) is relatively high after breast cancer surgery. Psychological factors, especially high pain catastrophising, are predictive of CPSP. Cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) can reduce anxiety and depression and help emotional self-regulation.

pmc-13198272.title: Inhalational therapy of pulmonary infection via macrophage-targeted nanoemulsions
pmc-13198272.creator: Hairui Wang, Jinghong Xian, Guonian Zhu, Zhiqiang Xie, Guangsheng Du, Yongshun Zhang, Lan Yang, Yunming Zhang, Teng Li, Yehui Zhou, Weimin Li, Xun Sun, Chengdi Wang
pmc-13198272.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The dynamic immune landscape within the tuberculous (TB) granuloma microenvironment critically governs antibiotic penetration efficiency, bacterial persistence, and long-term therapeutic outcomes. Herein, we present a macrophage-targeted inhalable nanoemulsion for co-delivering rifampicin and LCL161, an inhibitor of apoptosis protein antagonist. Inhaled mannose-nanoemulsions (named RL-NE@Man) enable granuloma-targeted delivery in TB mice model, increasing infected macrophage apoptosis, remodeling the tuberculosis microenvironment, and promoting T-cell immunity to synergize with antibiotics for the eradication of granulomas and persistent Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection.

pmc-13588354.description: BackgroundHealth problems experienced by children and youth with special health care needs (CYSHCN) impose an increasingly heavy cost burden on families and countries.
